verdict.rationale: Luma publishes a per-model credit price table (e.g., 20 credits for a 5s draft text-to-video or image-to-video clip), so a marketer can work out what a generation will cost before running it. Its platform also links a Billing Dashboard for spend afterwards, but the evidence never shows an in-product cost estimate at generation time or what the dashboard actually tracks. Missing for 10: per-generation cost preview shown before running, documented spend-tracking or usage-history detail, credit-to-dollar conversion, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see what a generation will cost in credits or dollars before running it, and track spend afterwards

citations.quote: The Luma API uses a credit system, not a subscription.
